<thought>The SMILES CCOC(=O)C1=C(OC2=C1C=C(C=C2)O)C3OC=CO3 matches the molecular formula C14H12O6 derived from the mass spectrum and contains an ethoxy ester (CH₃CH₂O‑C(=O)‑) as indicated by the ¹H NMR (triplet at 1.29 ppm, quartet at 4.30 ppm). Its aromatic pattern (four protons of a para‑disubstituted phenyl and three protons of a benzodioxole ring) fits the remaining NMR signals. Therefore this SMILES string is the most plausible structure for the sample.</thought>
<final_answer>CCOC(=O)C1=C(OC2=C1C=C(C=C2)O)C3OC=CO3</final_answer>
